heroTitleB: U diyaar garow shaqo ka jirta Finland.
heroLead: Baro Finnish wax ku ool ah adigoo ku tababaranaya hadalka, helaya jawaab-celin waxtar leh iyo hagitaan af aad hore u taqaan.
android: Waxa kale oo laga heli karaa Android
transition: KieliValmis waa magaca cusub ee macaamiishu u arkaan Floently Finnish. Akoonkaaga, horumarkaaga iyo rukhsaddaadu waxay ku sii socdaan isla adeegga.
pathKicker: Hal waddo waxbarasho oo isku xiran
pathTitle: Baro Finnish-ka aad u baahan tahay tallaabada xigta.
pathBody: U diyaar garowga imtixaanka, isgaarsiinta shaqada iyo Finnish-ka maalinlaha ah waa qayb ka mid ah hal safar waxbarasho.
card1Body: Ku tababar hadalka, qorista, akhriska iyo dhageysiga hawlo dhab u eg oo qaabka YKI ah.
card2Body: Ku tababar wada hadallada, su’aalaha iyo sharaxaadaha aad uga baahan tahay nolosha shaqada dhabta ah.
card3Body: Tababarka Finnish-ku Finnish ayuu ahaanayaa. Hagitaanka iyo jawaab-celinta waxaa lagu muujin karaa afka aad doorato.
ykiTitle: Tababar YKI oo isku xira xirfadaha.
ykiBody: Ku tababar isgaarsiinta, eeg jawaab-celinta oo mar kale isku day dhammaan afarta qaybood.
workTitle: Finnish loogu talagalay xaaladaha dhab ahaan ka dhaca shaqada.
workBody: Kobci erayada, naxwaha iyo ku hadalka adigoo adeegsanaya xaalado shaqo oo dhab u eg.
langKicker: Afkaaga ayaa kaa caawin kara barashada Finnish
langBody: Dooro afka aad sida ugu fiican u fahanto hagitaanka interface-ka, sharaxaadaha iyo jawaab-celinta.
langNote: Imtixaanka YKI laftiisa waxaa lagu qaadaa Finnish ama Swedish sida ay dhigayaan xeerarka rasmiga ah. KieliValmis ma sheeganayso in imtixaanka YKI lagu bixiyo 20 luqadood.
finalBody: U diyaar garow YKI, shaqo iyo Finnish-ka maalinlaha ah hal khibrad waxbarasho oo isku xiran.
